rootCause: M4 and M5 resources were provisioned only when the adapter's initial request enabled their research passes.
An initial Raw Debug frame disabled those request-level conditions, leaving no M5 research composite target.
Raw and M6 requests select WebGPU, so the host retained the same renderer generation when Raw Debug was turned off.
The later M6 request attempted to display the absent M5 composite, causing runtime failure, application WebGL fallback, and retry-latch consumption.
